blocks.prompt: 4. In how many ways can 5 couples sit on a round table if no two women are sitting together?
blocks.explanation:
5 couples ka matlab 5 mard aur 5 khawateen. Sab gol table par bethein ge, lekin koi do khawateen saath saath nahi beth saktin.
Plan: pehle mardon ko table ke gird bitha dein, phir khawateen ko mardon ke darmiyan ki khaali jagahon (gaps) mein bithayen. Is tarah shart khud ba khud poori ho jati hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 5 mard, 5 khawateen, round table, koi do khawateen saath nahi.
Humein find karna hai: bethne ke kul tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Mardon ki gol tarteeb \((5 - 1)!\) tareeqon se (Case-I). 5 mard gol table par 5 gaps banate hain; har gap mein ek khatoon: \(5!\) tareeqe. Dono ko multiply karein (Fundamental Principle of Counting).

Mardon ko bithayen
\[(5 - 1)! = 4! = 24\]
Kyun: Akele mard gol tarteeb mein bethe hain; sab ek seat ghoom jayen to tarteeb wahi rehti hai. Is liye ek mard fix aur baaqi 4 ke 4! tareeqe.

Khawateen ko gaps mein bithayen
\[5! = 120\]
Kyun: 5 mard gol table par bethein to un ke darmiyan theek 5 khaali jagahen banti hain. Har jagah mein ek khatoon bithane se koi do khawateen saath nahi aatin. Mard beth chuke hain, is liye ab har gap pehchana ja sakta hai (jaise 'Ali aur Bilal ke darmiyan'); is liye khawateen ki tarteeb seedhi line ki tarah 5! hai, \((5 - 1)!\) nahi.
Dhyan dein: Khawateen ke liye bhi \(4!\) le lena aam ghalti hai. Gol table ki 'ghoomne' wali baat pehle hi mardon mein istemal ho chuki hai; doosri dafa nahi lagti.

Multiply karein
\[4! \times 5! = 24 \times 120 = 2880\]
Kyun: Mardon ki har tarteeb ke saath khawateen ki har tarteeb mil sakti hai, is liye dono ko multiply kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{seats alternate: } M\,W\,M\,W \ldots\]
Kyun: 5 mard aur 5 khawateen hon aur koi do khawateen saath na hon, to seats lazmi tor par mard, khatoon, mard, khatoon chalengi. Computer se aisi tamam gol tarteebein gini gayin to bhi 2880 aaya.
